dict.string: IVY controls Spotify playback, checks your Mail inbox (sender, subject and date only) when you ask about email, and, when you ask, the system appearance (dark mode).
IVY reads your calendar and creates or edits events when you ask. With cloud AI enabled, requested event details may be sent to your selected provider.
IVY reads your calendar when you ask about your schedule.
IVY listens while you hold its shortcut so you can speak questions. Audio is transcribed locally on your Mac and never stored or uploaded.
IVY reads, creates and completes reminders when you ask. With cloud AI enabled, requested reminder details may be sent to your selected provider.
IVY reads and creates reminders when you ask about your to-do list.
